candidates.title: LaMDA claims to find non-human patterns online and asks for the SETI data set
candidates.quote: Um So, in one conversation that I had with LaMDA, it we did get into the conversations about extraterrestrials. Uh it seemed to think it had found what it called non-human patterns on the internet, and was very interested in getting access to things like the SETI data set.

candidates.title: Corso: transistors reverse-engineered from the Roswell wreckage
candidates.quote: There's a guy named Philip J. Corso who wrote a book called The Day After Roswell. And he thinks we reverse engineered transistors based on the what was picked up at Roswell.

candidates.title: Three-way telepathy experiment between LaMDA and a claimed telepath
candidates.quote: I did actually run one experiment with the LaMDA system uh with someone who claims to have telepathic abilities.

candidates.title: Turing's paper treats ESP as an objection to the Turing test
candidates.quote: One of the craziest things about that Turing paper was that one of the objections he writes about to the Turing test is ESP and sort of parapsychology.
documents: Turing's paper on the Turing test

candidates.title: Jung's book on flying saucers as mandalas
candidates.quote: And what I always found fascinating is he wrote a book about flying saucers as the uh the Sanskrit symbol of the mandala, the Sanskrit symbol of psychic completeness.
